programme.desc: Last Man Standing: All eyes are on Seth as he tries to prove he's worthy of the keys to the kingdom. But as business heats up, can he stay calm under the mounting pressure? (S6, ep 2)

programme.title: Storage Wars
programme.desc: The Donut Effect: Darrell finds a sweet way to distract the other bidders. Meanwhile, Jarrod and Brandi plan a four-year anniversary party for their Orange Store. (S6, ep 12)

programme.title: Storage Wars
programme.desc: The Gutfather: Rene gets superstitious as he hopes to strike it lucky for a second time at auctions in Fontana. Ivy goes with his gut. But will his instincts pay off? (S6, ep 17)

programme.desc: Grin And Barry It: Barry sets out to humiliate Ivy in the next set of auctions. Rene is in for a nasty surprise, while Jarrod and Brandi find themselves surrounded by pigs. (S6, ep 14)

programme.title: Storage Wars
programme.desc: The Adventures of Max Profit: Ivy is on the hunt for high-end items in Moreno Valley, while Jarrod reveals to Brandi an alter ego known as Max Profit. (S6, ep 15)

programme.title: Storage Wars
programme.desc: Follow all the drama as the buyers bid on more abandoned storage lockers. What treasures lie inside and can the dealers sell them on for a profit? (S6, ep 16)

programme.desc: All day long we are back in 1994! From chart-toppers to forgotten favourites, movie soundtracks to the headlines that made the year!

programme.title: 1994's Biggest Love Songs
programme.desc: All love songs, all Top 20 hits & all released in 1994! From Celine to Mariah, Take That to Boyzone, even Seal got there in the end! Who do you remember & who do you love the most?

programme.title: 30 Rock & Indie Heroes of the 10s
programme.desc: Claire Sturgess relives the 2010s with her 30 greatest heroes in rock and indie. The Vaccines, Biffy Clyro and Imagine Dragons are all in the Top 10, but who is her number 1?

programme.title: Weekend Anthems!
programme.desc: Turn it up to 11 all weekend for the finest rock anthems! Featuring Kings Of Leon, The Killers, Green Day, Biffy Clyro & The Foo Fighters. This is Now Rock!

programme.title: All Killer: Stateside Anthems!
programme.desc: In order, 20 of the biggest American anthems from the 21st Century featuring The Killers, Bon Jovi, Nickelback and OneRepublic.

programme.title: Party Rock Anthems!
programme.desc: Party pop rock anthems spanning 5 decades! From Queen, Kiss & Aerosmith to Blur, Paramore & The White Stripes.

programme.title: Rated Rock! The No.1s
programme.desc: Number 1 rock songs from the last 50 years! With mega hits from the Arctic Monkeys & KOL right back to legends like The Stones & T.Rex!

programme.title: 10 Biggest Legends Of The 80s
programme.desc: Rock Gods & Goddesses that were massive in the 80s & have stood the test of time ever since! Here are the 10 biggest selling & the most streamed legends the decade has to offer!

programme.title: Heart & Soul: 50 Rock Ballads
programme.desc: Carol Decker from T'Pau with 50 Rock Ballads written from the Heart and Soul! With Queen, Bon Jovi, Cutting Crew and Bonnie Tyler.

programme.title: Blazing Rock Ballads!
programme.desc: The Biggest Ballads from the royals of rock! From Queen, Bon Jovi & Whitesnake to Meat Loaf, Nickleback & Evanescence.

programme.title: 80s Soft Rock Classics
programme.desc: One hour of pure laid back tracks and big power ballads from the 80s, every song with a huge chorus! Expect plenty of Foreigner, Toto, U2 and Heart.

programme.title: The First Ladies of Rock 1985-2015
programme.desc: Starting in 1985, these are the power ladies who really rock! Expect Pink, Hayley Williams, Joan Jett, Sheryl Crow, Bonnie Tyler, Alanis Morissette & many more!

programme.title: Weekend Anthems!
programme.desc: Turn it up to 11 all weekend for the finest rock anthems! Featuring Kings Of Leon, The Killers, Green Day, Biffy Clyro & The Foo Fighters. This is Now Rock!

programme.title: Turn Up The 00s Anthems!
programme.desc: Turn up your speakers to 11 & live life even louder! 50 All-Killer Anthems in order from Blink 182 in 2000 to The Killers at the end of the Decade!

programme.title: The New Legends Of Rock
programme.desc: Rock Riffs, indie anthems and a new generation of rock legends from 2000 to now! Expect YungBlud, BMTH, The Arctic Monkeys, Fall Out Boy & loads more!

programme.title: Alex Baker's 30 Emo Anthems
programme.desc: Alex serves up 30 of the greatest, darkest, skinny jeans-iest, heavy eye makeup-iest & back-combed hair-iest anthems from the worlds most glorious miserable genre!

programme.title: Weekend Rock Anthems
programme.desc: Your weekend anthems and the biggest rock songs from the last 50 years! From the Beatles and the Stones in the 60s right through to One Republic and Kings Of Leon in the 10s.

programme.title: Kurt Cobain: Fan Favourites
programme.desc: From 1991 to 1994 - 40 minutes of the biggest rock songs from the legendary Kurt Cobain!

programme.title: Sunday Rock Classics
programme.desc: Rounding off the week with rock classics and anthems! We guarantee AC/DC, Nirvana, Queen, Meat Loaf, Bon Jovi & much more!

programme.title: Robin Banks 90s Antiques Rockshow
programme.desc: Crammed full with extraordinary finds, hidden treasures, and plenty of old relics! From the Stones and Genesis, to Iggy and Aerosmith - how many of these family heirlooms do you own?

programme.title: The 90s: Guitars, Grunge & Glory!
programme.desc: Grunge happened, we kept the guitars! Britpop happened, we kept the Gallaghers! Nirvana brought angst, Blur brought swagger & everyone brought riffs, anthems & questionable hair!

programme.title: 99 Reasons The 90s Rocked!
programme.desc: 99 anthems of rock from the decade that dominated the genre! With Aerosmith, Bon Jovi, Nirvana, Skunk Anansie, Meat Loaf and U2.

programme.title: Nicky Horne's Highway To Hell
programme.desc: Buckle up & join Nicky for a journey down the dark roads of rock! Monsters of metal, Ghastly Axe grinders & Devilish anthems. It's going to be a spine-tingling, HELL of a ride!

programme.title: Monsters of 80s Rock!
programme.desc: Non-stop 80s rock monsters! From Queen, Bon Jovi & Whitesnake to Meat Loaf, U2, The Damned & Billy Idol.

programme.title: Rosko's Hellraisers! Top 25
programme.desc: From our sister channel NOW 70s, the biggest rock n roll rebels. Presented by the man who was there "that groovy host from the west coast" Radio 1 legend Rosko!

programme.title: Cellar Club with Caroline Munro
programme.desc: That is all from the Cellar Club tonight and Caroline Munro is here to bring the night to a close.

programme.title: The Executioner
programme.desc: 1970. Thriller. Directed by Sam Wanamaker. Stars George Peppard, Joan Collins & Judy Geeson. A British agent is determined to prove that a respected colleague is really a Soviet spy.

programme.title: Meet John Doe
programme.desc: 1941. Drama. Directed by Frank Capra. Stars Gary Cooper, Barbara Stanwyck & Edward Arnold. A drifter finds himself at the centre of a political movement after becoming part of a fraudulent story.

programme.title: Scotland Yard
programme.desc: 1956. The Case of the River Morgue. Directed by Montgomery Tully. Starring Hugh Moxey, Gordon Needham and Jane Welsh. The police are summoned when a dead body is stolen. (S1, E16)

programme.title: The Vise
programme.desc: Week-End Guest. 1955. Stars Ron Randell, Mary Hinton & Kenneth Haigh. A young reporter is sent by a London newspaper to interview a woman regarding a celebrated author.

programme.title: Batman
programme.desc: The Joker Goes to School. 1966. Stars Adam West, Cesar Romero & Kip King. Batman and Robin attempt to put a stop to the Joker's plot to recruit high school dropouts into his gang.

programme.title: Batman
programme.desc: He Meets His Match, the Grisly Ghoul. 1966. Stars Adam West, Cesar Romero & Neil Hamilton. Robin agrees to infiltrate the Bad Pennies in a dangerous undercover mission.

programme.title: Target Earth
programme.desc: 1954. Sci-Fi. Directed by Sherman A. Rose. Starring Richard Denning. A large city is ordered to be completely evacuated as an army of robots, believed to be from the planet Venus, attack it.

programme.title: The Dragon of Pendragon Castle
programme.desc: 1950. Family. Directed by John Baxter. Stars Leslie Bradley, David Hannaford & J. Hubert Leslie. An old man lives with his two grandchildren in a cold, drafty castle where they discover a dragon.

programme.title: Runaround
programme.desc: 1981. Presented by Mike Reid. Features Barry Sheene. Prizes include a digital watch & a pocket computer. This episode was recorded on Charles & Diana's wedding day and features grand prix motorbikes.

programme.title: Legend of the Hidden City
programme.desc: 1997. Stars Brendan Pollecutt, Fezile Mpela & Robert Finlayson. Kabeth and Ammon get help to get hold of the scrolls; Morgan prepares his men to break into the prison and Ram captures Dean.

programme.title: William Tell
programme.desc: The Young Widow. 1959. Stars: Conrad Phillips, Willoughby Goddard & Jennifer Jayne. Having escaped from Gessler's troops, Tell and his wife are given refuge by the beautiful Countess von Marheim.

programme.title: Hawkeye & the Last of the Mohicans
programme.desc: Winter Passage. 1957. Directed by Sam Newfield. Stars John Hart, Lon Chaney Jr.& Kay Hawtrey. Frontier wives hope to join their husbands in time for Christmas.

programme.title: The Lone Ranger
programme.desc: Lone Ranger Triumphs. 1949. Stars Jay Silverheels, Clayton Moore & John Hart. The Lone Ranger still on the trail of Butch Cavendish and his gang sends Tonto to the town of Colby.

programme.title: Supercar
programme.desc: Flight of Fancy. 1961. Stars David Graham & Graydon Gould. Jimmy falls asleep reading about the missing princess of Barania. He wakes and steals Supercar to launch a dangerous rescue operation.

programme.title: The Adventures of Robin Hood
programme.desc: The Borrowed Baby. 1957. Stars Richard Greene, Bernadette O'Farrell & Sylvia Kay. The Sheriff plots to arrest Maid Marian for assisting Robin and the outlaws, using a borrowed baby as bait.

programme.title: Attack from Space
programme.desc: 1965. Sci-fi. Directed by Koreyoshi Akasaka, Teruo Ishii & Akira Mitsuwa. Stars Ken Utsui & Sachihiro Ohsawa. The rulers of planet Emerald send superhero Starman to protect Earth from evil aliens.

programme.title: I'm All Right Jack
programme.desc: 1959. Comedy. Director: John Boulting. Stars Peter Sellers, Terry-Thomas & Ian Carmichael. After leaving the army, upper class Windrush takes a job in industry. He then accidently starts a strike.

programme.title: Scales of Justice
programme.desc: 1963. Undesirable Neighbour. Stars Vanda Godsell & Bridget Armstrong. Based on a real case, a newly married woman becomes very friendly with her male neighbours. (S1, E05)

programme.title: This Happy Breed
programme.desc: 1944. Drama. Director: David Lean. Stars Robert Newton, Celia Johnson, John Mills & Stanley Holloway. After WW1, a family lead an ordinary sort of life until the outbreak of WW2.

programme.title: Dick Turpin
programme.desc: Sentence of Death: Part 1. 1982. Stars Richard O'Sullivan & Alfie Bass. After spending years imprisoned in Jamaica, Barnaby Husk seeks revenge. Isaac Rag takes King George's cousin under his wing.

programme.title: Maigret
programme.desc: Inspector Lognon's Triumph. 1961. Stars Rupert Davies, Neville Jason & Henry Oscar. Maigret works on a case with his old rival, the constantly miserable Inspector Lognon.

programme.title: Lillie
programme.desc: Emilie. 1978. Stars Francesca Annis, Anton Rodgers, Patrick Holt. On Jersey, young Emelie Charlotte Le Breton grows up as one of the boys, but her mother takes her to London to show her a Season.

programme.title: Our Man Flint
programme.desc: 1966. Comedy. Directed by Daniel Mann. Stars James Coburn, Lee Cobb & Gila Golan. Top agent Derek Flint is called in to investigate why the world is being affected by extreme, violent weather.

programme.title: EuroTrash
programme.desc: 1998. Hosted by Antoine de Caunes. Tonight, Lolo shows us her bicycle pumps, there's a backstage look at the reigning queen of finish fitness and take an onstage dive with some naked Austrians.

programme.title: Around the World in 80 Raves
programme.desc: 2001. Stars Vernon Kay, Paul Eastwood & Glenn Ward. Following a group of young people around America as they go to various raves, nightclubs, events and other parties.

programme.title: The Murder Mansion
programme.desc: 1972. Horror. A young couple become lost and refuge in an old mansion. During the night they are drawn into a web of ghostly apparitions, legends of witchcraft and a series of supernatural deaths.

programme.title: Cactus Flower
programme.desc: 1969. Comedy. Directed by Gene Saks. Stars Walter Matthau, Ingrid Bergman & Goldie Hawn. A dentist convinces his assistant to pose as his wife so he can avoid marrying his girlfriend.

programme.title: The Brigitte Bardot Story
programme.desc: French actress and singer Brigitte Bardot rose to fame with films that challenged conservative norms. This documentary tells the story of her becoming an international icon and sex symbol.

programme.title: Calling All Cars
programme.desc: 1954. Starring Cardew Robinson, Adrienne Fancey, John Fitzgerald and Pauline Olsen. Comedy documentary, centring on the Dover Harbour car terminal. Directed by Maclean Rogers.

programme.title: One Step Beyond
programme.desc: The Open Window. 1959. Stars Michael Higgins, Louise Fletcher & Charles Seel. A temperamental artist has a premonition of a woman's death in a neighbouring building.

programme.title: Design for Loving
programme.desc: 1962. Comedy. Director: Godfrey Grayson. Stars June Thorburn, Pete Murray & Soraya Rafat. Barbara Winters hires beatnik Stanford as her chief fashion adviser which leads to comedic complications.

programme.title: Look At Life The Dance of Life
programme.desc: 1960. A look at English folk dancing, including the Hobby Horse Dance and the Furry Dance.

programme.title: The Lucy Show
programme.desc: Little Old Lucy. 1967. Stars Lucille Ball, Gale Gordon & Dennis Day. Mr. Mooney asks Lucy to disguise herself as a 'little old lady' to escort the aging bank president to the annual banquet.

programme.title: Sherlock Holmes
programme.desc: The Mother Hubbard Case. 1954. Starring: Ronald Howard, Howard Marion-Crawford & Archie Duncan. Sherlock Holmes tracks down a murderer who lures victims to empty houses, where they are killed.

programme.title: The Sundowners
programme.desc: 1950. Western. Directed by George Templeton. Stars Robert Preston, Robert Sterling & Chill Wills. Brothers on opposite sides of the law unite to save the family cattle ranch from rustlers.

programme.title: Sheffield Anglers 1960s - Glimpses
programme.desc: Charming documentary made in the 1960s following the exodus of 100s of men every Sunday from Sheffield to Lincolnshire, Kirkstead for the weekly fishing competition.

programme.title: Heavens Above!
programme.desc: 1963. Comedy. Directed by John & Roy Boulting. Stars Peter Sellers, Ian Carmichael, Cecil Parker & Eric Sykes. Due to mistaken identity, a minister is accidently appointed to a snobbish parish.

programme.title: Pollyanna
programme.desc: 2002. Drama. Directed by Sarah Harding. Stars Amanda Burton, Tom Bell & Kenneth Cranham. Young orphan Pollyanna, bringing mirth and mayhem to her new home, goes to stay with her Aunt Polly.

programme.title: That's My Boy
programme.desc: What Seems to be the Trouble? 1985. Stars Mollie Sugden, Christopher Blake & Jennifer Lonsdale. Ida struggles to adjust to her new Yorkshire home, but a medical emergency soon changes her mind.

programme.title: For the Love of Ada
programme.desc: The Royalist. Stars: Wilfred Pickles, Irene Handl & Jack Smethurst. It's the Queen's birthday and Ada's hoping for a personal reply to the birthday card she sent. (S3, E06)

programme.title: The Man from U.N.C.L.E
programme.desc: The Very Important Zombie Affair. 1965. Stars Robert Vaughn, David McCallum & Claude Akins. The team travel to the Caribbean to investigate a strange plot to turn people into zombies using voodoo.

programme.title: The Footage Detectives
programme.desc: Take a glorious trip back to Lancashire in 1948... to celebrate bleach, then let's cycle back to the 50s, and remember to bring your wheelbarrows - there's a new way to make a bob or two!
